business_problem: Customer care agents and operational experts across Allianz entities in Germany had to navigate the AWISO knowledge library, an extensive repository of thousands of documents, making information retrieval slow and difficult, especially for new team members handling customer issues.
solution_summary: Allianz built the Enterprise Knowledge Assistant (EKA) as an internal AI knowledge assistant for call center and operations teams. The system sits on Allianz’s Future Cloud platform and uses large language model applications with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), model finetuning, and a multi-agent design to turn large internal document collections into an interactive chatbot experience. EKA searches the AWISO knowledge library and other document databases, identifies relevant passages, highlights the right information, generates summaries, and links users back to the original source content. The platform processes large text corpora by chunking up to 90,000 paragraphs into retrievable units, then serves precise answers through a conversational interface for agents, back-office staff, and underwriters. Built-in user feedback helps continuously refine response quality, while localized implementations allow the same framework to be adapted for different Allianz entities and infrastructure environments.

solution_components.name: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant (EKA)

solution_components.name: AWISO knowledge library

solution_components.name: Future Cloud platform
solution_components.role: Hosts the commercial and open-source AI technologies that give EKA scalable, reliable, and adaptable runtime infrastructure.

data_flow: Guidance documents from the AWISO knowledge library and other document databases are processed into manageable chunks on Allianz’s Future Cloud platform. EKA uses RAG, finetuning, and multi-agent logic to retrieve relevant passages, generate contextual answers and summaries, and return links to full source content through a chatbot used by call center agents and other staff.
integration_points: call center agents and operational experts
business_outcome: EKA reduces the time employees spend searching through documentation, improves answer accuracy, helps agents resolve customer queries faster, supports higher first-contact resolution, and improves customer and employee experience while scaling across Allianz operations.
metrics: accuracy rate exceeding 90% for common queries

tested in more than ten use-cases
